column1: # EU Building Stock Observatory (BSO) -- Greece residential indicators
# Used by 03_heat_intensity.py for (1) the unknown-cohort stock-weighted
# fallback intensity and (2) the BSO reconciliation row.
# stock_pct_el: share of the Greek residential stock by construction cohort.
#   ~58-60% of Greek buildings predate 1980 (no thermal insulation regs).
#   Distribution approximated from ELSTAT and TABULA Greece. Sums to 100.
#   heat intensity (delivered). DERIVED from the Greek TABULA per-cohort
#   class-average space-heating need x retrofit blend (0.9325) + DHW.
